officialTitle: I Let Non-Engineers Vibe-Code Our Production Codebase

chapters.title: Introduction: opening the codebase to non-engineers
The Slack coworker and pull-request workflow
Giving agents codebase and business context
Building Leidang and an agent-agnostic runtime
Non-engineers, preview links and adoption numbers
Examples from product, design, support and QA
A deployment near miss, guardrails and review bottlenecks
Four lessons: coworker, access, guardrails and context

existingSummary: Viljami Kuosmanen shares epilot’s experiment giving product managers, designers and customer-success staff access to coding agents in Slack. He shows real contributions, explains why shared context and preview links matter, and describes a deployment near miss that led to tighter permissions and engineer review.
